question: How many people in the UK have hearing loss?
slides: About *18 million* UK adults have hearing loss.
Live captions for in-person talk, *on your phone.*
description: About 18 million adults in the UK, 1 in 3, have hearing loss in one or both ears, according to a 2024 University of Manchester analysis.
Captio AI is a live captions app made for deaf and hard of hearing people, for in-person conversations.
The University of Manchester says the figure is 12.3 million, or 1 in 4 adults aged 18 to 80, when only hearing loss in both ears is counted.
The 2024 estimate used the 2021 Scottish census and the 2022 England and Wales census, and the study was published in the International Journal of Audiology.
RNID says 65% of people over 60 in the UK have hearing loss, and almost 80% of people aged 70 or over, using the 1995 National Study of Hearing.
Captio AI shows what the person across the desk at a UK doctor's appointment is saying as text on your phone while they are still speaking.
Captio AI captions 60 languages including English, and lets you add names and medical terms so they are recognized.
Captio AI is free to download and gives 100 free credits a day on the free plan.
Live captions in Captio AI need internet and can contain mistakes, so confirm medical instructions with your doctor, and Captio AI does not replace an interpreter.
